item.title: Farmlands appoints new board chair in wake of AgriZeroNZ investment backlash

item.title: 'Real need': Frustration over lack of effluent stops for livestock carriers
item.description: Livestock carrier drivers are frustrated a truck stop and service station hub on the Heretaunga Plains won't be going ahead on agricultural land considered too productive.
